metadata.title: Emerald Case · Custom phone-case commerce
metadata.description: A compact product and engineering case study for a multilingual custom phone-case storefront with uploads, accounts, checkout and transactional email.

hero.title: From personal image to checkout in one flow.
hero.intro: A multilingual storefront that lets people turn their own image into a custom phone case, then move through account, order and payment flows without losing context.

live.title: Build a case in the real product.
live.description: Open the storefront to explore the upload, customization, authentication and checkout journey directly.

screenshot.alt: Emerald Case homepage with its custom phone-case builder and product preview

product.title: Personalization carried through commerce.
product.description: The core product idea stays visible from landing page to purchase: the customer’s own image is the product, not an optional detail hidden after signup.

features.title: Image-led customizer
features.text: Upload and preview a personal image as the center of the phone-case creation flow.

features.title: Account journeys
features.text: Authentication connects saved user context to orders and the wider shopping experience.

features.title: Integrated checkout
features.text: Stripe completes the purchase path while order data remains tied to the customized product.

features.title: Localized, responsive UI
features.text: Language switching, theme support and responsive layouts keep the product coherent across contexts.

engineering.title: Product state from upload to order.
engineering.description: The full-stack architecture joins client customization state, persisted product data, payment processing and transactional email in one product journey.

notes.title: Focused client state
notes.text: Zustand and React Context separate fast customization interactions from shared application state.

notes.title: Typed persistence
notes.text: Prisma provides a typed data layer over MongoDB for users, products and order workflows.

notes.title: Commerce services
notes.text: Stripe handles payment flow and Resend supports the transactional communication around it.
